philosophy: Voice and evidence remain foreground. Music supports structure and tension but never implies facts or guilt.
editorialRules: No sensational hit/stinger directly under an allegation or disputed claim.
No police sirens, gunshots, courtroom gavels, cash-register sounds, or similar literalizing SFX unless they are authentic sourced audio identified in the episode.
Music may signal chapter structure, uncertainty, reflection, or momentum; it must not manufacture evidentiary meaning.
All third-party audio requires asset-registry provenance and license clearance.
